scenes.title: Level 6: First songs
scenes.subtitle: Play real songs
lines: Play real songs with just a few chords each — Skip to My Lou, Down in the Valley, Amazing Grace, When the Saints, and Oh!

scenes.heading: In this level
lines: After this level, you'll be able to play four simple songs: Skip to My Lou, Down in the Valley, Amazing Grace, and Oh!
Each uses just two or three chords, so you can start sharing your music with friends right away.

scenes.heading: Songs you'll play
points: When the Saints Go Marching In
lines: These songs are simple and fun, perfect for building confidence as you play your first full tunes.
Let's start with Skip to My Lou.
